## What you will learn

One line that starts with a verb, such as trace, prove, write or measure.

What happens today, in plain words. Use synthetic names only.

# one command that shows the gap

## Done when

- A new test fails on main today and passes after the fix.
- One change to the fix turns the test red again.
- `make check` passes.
